name: Fairburn Regional Distribution Center - Fairburn GA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via EPA RMP record (Fairburn Regional Distribution Center, 1555 Oakley Industrial Blvd) + Panjiva buyer record (S.C. Johnson & Son Inc., 1555 Oakley Ind Blvd Fairburn GA) + Waze 'Exel Logistics/SC Johnson & Son Inc' listing. Atlanta-metro aerosol RDC, operated with Exel/DHL. SCJ building is the LEFT (western) of two warehouses, identified by the distinctive curved truck-loop apron at its south end; the right building (1525 Oakley) is a separate tenant.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access drive enters the property from the NE off Oakley Industrial Blvd through a wooded buffer. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint structure on the drive or at the building loop in Street View (Feb 2022). Open site within a wooded industrial park.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at the access drive or anywhere on the truck loop road.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: continuous dock banks on BOTH long faces (west face fronts a trailer drop yard, east face has docks with trailers backed in). Shipping and receiving run from separate dock clusters on opposite faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along both ~330m long faces; ~95 trailers backed in across the imagery -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved drop yards flank both long faces full of trailers parked without tractors -> 50+.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: No gate, so no pre-gate staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The wide curved truck-loop apron at the south end functions as an internal staging/queue area before the dock faces.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck aprons and the large curved southern loop give ample paved width to add an express lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The private access drive plus the deep wrap-around loop road comfortably hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Wooded industrial-park setting on the southern edge of the Atlanta metro near I-85; tree buffers and low surrounding density -> judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single open access drive; lane count approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimate from perimeter box covering the building, both drop yards and the southern loop apron.

citations.claim: DHL Supply Chain WARN for 1555 Oakley Industrial Blvd, Fairburn GA, 211 employees, layoff effective 2024-08-31.
CoStar: 'DHL to close two operations near Atlanta' (1555 Oakley Fairburn + McDonough), ~210 jobs, summer 2024.

verification.rationale: The Exel/DHL-operated SCJ RDC at 1555 Oakley closed via June-2024 WARN (effective Aug 31 2024) and the building has been re-leased; all positive SCJ signals predate the closure.
